name: BFB
rootCause: Flash loan exploit targeting deflationary reserve-burn logic in _priceDeflPool() (Contract.sol:448). Function burns 5% of LP pair's BFB and calls sync() when price drops >5% below fallLastPrice. Guard only required EOA checks, allowing attacker to trigger repeatedly with zero-value self-transfers across 151 rounds. Collapsed BFB/WBNB pair reserve toward zero, enabling dust BFB swaps for entire WBNB reserve (~350.6 WBNB). Attack Tx: https://bscscan.com/tx/0xabcf5c5c846595b2d0849f2579b67465ed8d06f3b469cee5e3a57c1f7aed3520 Source: https://twitter.com/DefimonAlerts/status/2075080496573284853

descriptions.text: Flash loan exploit targeting deflationary reserve-burn logic in _priceDeflPool() (Contract.sol:448). Function burns 5% of LP pair's BFB and calls sync() when price drops >5% below fallLastPrice. Guard only required EOA checks, allowing attacker to trigger repeatedly with zero-value self-transfers across 151 rounds. Collapsed BFB/WBNB pair reserve toward zero, enabling dust BFB swaps for entire WBNB reserve (~350.6 WBNB). Attack Tx: https://bscscan.com/tx/0xabcf5c5c846595b2d0849f2579b67465ed8d06f3b469cee5e3a57c1f7aed3520 Source: https://twitter.com/DefimonAlerts/status/2075080496573284853

BFB Token was exploited on BNB Chain on July 8, 2026, due to zero-value transfer abuse in its price-defense logic. The attacker drained approximately 350.62 WBNB (~$197,800) by repeatedly triggering reserve burns in the PancakeSwap pool without expending tokens. The BFBToken contract failed to check transfer amount before executing price-defense side effects. This enabled repeated zero-value transferFrom() calls,each triggering reserve burns,allowing pool depletion by an attacker without genuine token movement or value input.
